import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN], invFac = new int[MAXN], f = new int[MAXN];
    static int[][] fa = new int[20][1 << 20], fc = new int[20][1 << 20];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();

        int maskVal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((n >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                maskVal |= (1 << i);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= maskVal; i++) {
            int t = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                if (((n >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    t <<= 1;
                    t |= ((i >> j) & 1);
                }
            }
            f[t] = i;
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(k), BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(p)).intValue());
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % p);
        }

        invFac[MAXN - 1] = modInverse(fac[MAXN - 1], p);
        for (int i = MAXN - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFac[i] = (int)((long)invFac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p);
        }

        int size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                fa[i][j] = (j <= maskVal) ? a[j] : 0;
            }
            transformBitwise(fa[i], size, p, false);
        }

        int[] a = new int[maskVal + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maskVal; i++) {
            a[i] = invFac[f[i]];
        }

        a = subsetPower(a, k, p);

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            transformBitwise(fc[i], size, p, true);
        }

        int res = (int)(modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(k), BigInteger.valueOf(n), BigInteger.valueOf(p)).longValue());
        int subtractVal = (int)((long)a[maskVal] * fac[n] % p);
        res = (res - subtractVal + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static void transformBitwise(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean inv) {
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += (len << 1)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
                    int u = a[i + j], v = a[i + j + len];
                    if (!inv) {
                        a[i + j] = (u + v) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[i + j] = (u - v + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPower(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = 1;
        while (n < a.length) n <<= 1;
        int[][] faArr = new int[20][n];
        int[][] fcArr = new int[20][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                faArr[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
            }
            transformBitwise(faArr[i], n, p, false);
        }

        int[] v = new int[20];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                v[j] = faArr[j][i];
            }
            v = powerConvolution(v, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                fcArr[j][i] = v[j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            transformBitwise(fcArr[i], n, p, true);
        }

        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(j);
            if (c < 20 && j < a.length) {
                res[j] = fcArr[c][j];
            } else {
                res[j] = 0;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int[] powerConvolution(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) return a;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            int[] temp = powerConvolution(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)temp[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] half = powerConvolution(a, k / 2, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)half[i] * half[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static BigInteger modPow(BigInteger base, BigInteger exp, BigInteger mod) {
        return base.modPow(exp, mod);
    }

    static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
        return BigInteger.valueOf(a).modInverse(BigInteger.valueOf(m)).intValue();
    }
}
